text:
Maya: Quick sync — we're planning to expose the hidden preferences panel (beta) in Console next week. Want to lock down flags, canary scope, and guardrails before the rollout.

Priya: Which feature flag keys are we using? and who gets initial access?

Maya: Flags: `console.hidden_prefs_ui` (master toggle) and `console.hidden_prefs_ui_beta_group` (audience). Initial access = internal + 5% external orgs (beta cohort).

Alex: +1 on 5% start. We should add an admin override (for CS/SE) and ensure audit logs capture toggles.

Juan: What telemetry should we watch for early signs of regressions? errors, load, support spikes?

Maya: Minimal set: error rate (Console.HiddenPrefs.ErrorRate), render latency P95, number of saves/changes, and support ticket count with tag `hidden-prefs`. Also event: `hidden_prefs.opened` and `hidden_prefs.save_failed`.

Sasha: For Dedicated/Private customers, this must be disabled by default unless explicitly opt-in. Confirming we don't leak any experimental flags into customer-managed UIs.

Maya: Correct — `console.hidden_prefs_ui` defaults OFF for Private and Dedicated in install profiles. Only hosted beta can auto-enable. We'll add a CI check to prevent shipping a build with the flag forced on for private images.

Priya: Can someone paste the CLI toggle command I'll use during the canary?

Maya: Sure — CLI snippet:```bash
rdw flags set console.hidden_prefs_ui --on --audience=beta_group --note "canary 5%"
rdw flags set console.hidden_prefs_ui_beta_group --include org_ids:123,456 --percentage 5
```

Alex: Will the rollout support gradual ramp in LaunchDarkly style? or do we need manual updates?

Maya: LaunchDarkly supports percentage ramps; for internal we use our FD flag service which also supports percentage + explicit org lists. Priya will author the ramp plan in the rollout PR.

Juan: What are the rollback criteria? e.g., error rate > 3% sustained for 10m, or > 20% increase in support mentions within 24h?

Maya: Proposed guardrails:
- Auto-pause if Console.HiddenPrefs.ErrorRate > 3% for 10 continuous minutes
- Manual rollback if support tickets with `hidden-prefs` exceed baseline by 20% over 24h
- CPU/GPU unaffected but watch p95 render latency > 500ms for three intervals

Priya: I'll add these to the PR and include Datadog alert snippets. Example alert: `avg(last_5m):increase(Console.HiddenPrefs.ErrorRate) > 0.03`

Sasha: Also enforce RBAC: only org admins can change persistent prefs. UI should surface a lock icon for settings that require org-admins.

Maya: Good call. We'll include a quick UX note for that and a small e2e that checks RBAC.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: canary flags rollout job queued for 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC — job id `deploy-9892`. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

Alex: I'll add a lightweight smoke test that opens the prefs panel and saves a key. Can be run in the canary lane.

Priya: Opening the rollout PR now: rdw/console#4216 — includes flag names, ramp schedule (5 -> 25 -> 100), Datadog alerts, and docs update.

Maya: Thanks — who wants to review the PR? @Alex @Juan please. If green, target to start canary on Monday.

Juan: I'll review today and ping back.

Alex: Reviewing after stand.

Priya: Added notes for customer comms: short banner for beta orgs, opt-out link in account settings, and a KB draft for CS.

Maya: Perfect. Keep this thread updated with any rollback actions or unexpected telemetry. Thanks all. :pray:
